title: JRE 2341 - Bernie Sanders
guestBio: Bernie Sanders is the senior United States senator from Vermont. See him live on the Fighting Oligarchy tour.
tldr: Bernie Sanders and Joe discuss economic inequality in America and why Bernie believes billionaire oligarchy has captured both major political parties
Bernie makes his case for universal healthcare and explains in detail why he believes the current system is structurally designed to profit from illness
Discussion of the Fighting Oligarchy tour and why Bernie is still taking his message directly to working Americans decades into his political career
Joe pushes back on Bernie's economic positions and the two find genuine common ground on several issues that cut across typical partisan lines
Conversation covers the influence of billionaire donor money on the political system and what genuine campaign finance reform would actually require
Bernie on running for president twice, what he would do differently, and whether he believes the political movement he built has lasting power
